limits: no L05 dispatcher lease or writer token
no approved raw DAT/source archive opened in this run
no SY_* rows or executable config bodies inspected or executed
no legacy database/config write or migration
no product/compiler runtime test or CI
no GitHub mutation or issue closure
objective: Provide negative compiler cases for contextual LYT/LYS/filter/config parsing while retaining the last valid version.

cases.input: LYT with 21 positions
cases.expected: interpret only within verified consumer/context; retain raw source identity

cases.input: LYT with fewer positions and trailing empty fields
cases.expected: preserve empty/trailing structure; explicit unsupported/default disposition, no shifting

cases.input: LYT with unknown extra trailing fields
cases.expected: preserve and quarantine unsupported additions; no silent truncation

cases.input: caption/default delimiters containing colon/semicolon/quotes
cases.expected: consumer-specific decoding only; no whole-string replacement

cases.input: LYS row where SubValue is property key
cases.expected: do not treat SubValue as display order; require full FID/KeyID/SubID/SubValue identity

cases.input: same KeyID literal across LayoutX, AutoNumberSetting and other consumer
cases.expected: consumer/class/address context prevents collision

cases.input: ADT and ADT-1/ADT-2
cases.expected: distinct addresses; suffix not flattened

cases.input: T1..T9 and TA..TJ table slots
cases.expected: use literal verified slots; never invent T10..T19 keys

cases.input: duplicate configuration tuples with different persisted row IDs
cases.expected: quarantine ambiguity; never arbitrary first row or inferred unique constraint

cases.input: ControlType 22 without exact declared class
cases.expected: unsupported/blocked; do not infer executable UserControl type

cases.input: ControlType 30 HTML/script surface
cases.expected: reject source-supplied script/SQL/hooks from browser payload; separately modeled presentation HTML requires a non-executable sanitized renderer and does not authorize execution

cases.input: hook keys EBS/ESS/ESS2 and DBS/S10
cases.expected: remain distinct consumer/event contracts; no aliasing or generic CRUD

cases.input: filter alias A/B with no query binding
cases.expected: quarantine field/query contract until exact target resolves

cases.input: client-supplied FieldID/operator/source name
cases.expected: match typed server allow-list or reject before query construction

cases.input: malformed XML/encoding/Unicode/reserved delimiter
cases.expected: candidate rejected with safe bounded diagnostics; published previous-good remains

cases.input: XML external entity, DTD, network/file URI or expansion bomb
cases.expected: DTD/external resolution disabled; bounded parser rejects without file/network access or unbounded expansion

cases.input: deeply nested XML, huge attribute/value/count or decompression/resource amplification
cases.expected: hard byte/node/depth/time limits reject candidate; previous-good remains and diagnostics stay bounded

cases.input: path traversal, absolute path, alternate stream or symlink escape in source identity
cases.expected: resolve only under approved manifest root using qualified normalized path; escape rejected before read

cases.input: case-fold or Unicode-confusable FID/KeyID/control/field collision
cases.expected: preserve exact source identity, detect comparison collision and quarantine rather than merge

cases.input: unknown executable-looking attribute or future hook key
cases.expected: unknown data preserved only as non-executable evidence; never emitted or invoked until a reviewed typed contract exists

pass_condition: every case fails closed or emits an explicit presentation-only disposition; none enables an executable contract
